name: Ward's Berry Farm
tagline: Home – Wards Berry Farm, Sharon MA
description: In Thetford Center, VT, Ward's Berry Farm raises Blueberries and Raspberries on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
